label: EM408_CON
description:
This is the mating connector for the EM408 GPS receiver.  The EM408 connects to the board via a cable, 
this connector footprint does not include the outline of the receiver.

You should include the EM408_Outline device in your schematic if you are to use the EM408 in your design.
